CIRCUIT OPERATION
• When the power window switch is operated up or 
down, the operation side relay turns on, the 
power window motor operates, and opens or 
closes the door window <LH>.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
• The cause may be a malfunction of the power 
window motor <LH> drive circuit.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the power window relay.
• Malfunction of the ETACS-ECU. 
• Damaged harness wires or connectors.
